label: Finding-8
title: most-severe: Cited Wiz source does not say it; the real origin is uncited
description: The claim cites wiz-blog-php2shell, whose wording is 'among the most severe ... in PHP'. The 'ever detected by AI' framing appears in the BBC and, as a WSJ quote of Wiz's co-founder ('the most severe AI vulnerability that was ever found'), in substack-lopezkurtz-patch-is-the-exploit. Cite the Substack relay and label the claim as a quote of a quote from the WSJ.
